verdict.rationale: Sill is an open-source Mac-to-iPhone/iPad remote screen app. Remote-access products can plausibly offer official SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only building the app itself from source with SwiftPM and running the host from the command line; neither is an official SDK for building against Sill. The only SDK mention says the apps contain no third-party SDKs, which is unrelated, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
